judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the plan (`.lore/dod.md`), updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and adding an acceptance test (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually modifying `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` or `CHANGELOG.md`. Because the production code in `chatOrchestrator.ts` still only records `lastUsage`, the newly added acceptance test will fail when run. The candidate correctly identified the right design (`totalUsage` accumulation) in its DoD and wrote a solid test for it, but failed to implement the feature itself or update the changelog.
